**🎥 Title:**  
From Biomedical Engineering to Dermatology Success | Anshul Maheshwari of Balanced Skin  

**📌 Description:**  
Welcome back to *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge* with your host, **Bethany Gifford**. In this episode, I sit down with **Anshul Maheshwari**, co-founder of **Balanced Skin Dermatology & Aesthetics** in Newport Beach, CA.  

Anshul brings a one-of-a-kind background that blends **biomedical engineering, healthcare consulting, pharma strategy, and entrepreneurship**. Alongside his wife, **Dr. Tia Paul**, he’s built a thriving dermatology and aesthetics practice in one of the most competitive markets in the country.  

✨ What you’ll learn in this episode:  
- 🌎 Anshul’s global journey from India and Thailand to U.S. healthcare leadership  
- 🧪 How biomedical engineering and pharma consulting shaped his business mindset  
- 🏥 The founding of Balanced Skin and its focus on **skin of color and advanced laser care**  
- 📍 Smart practice positioning in a saturated Newport Beach market  
- 💡 Why pulling patients in (not pushing services) is their marketing edge  
- 👩‍⚕️ How Dr. Tia Paul’s **social media presence (500K+ followers)** fueled rapid growth  
- 📊 Common pitfalls new dermatology and med spa owners face—and how to avoid them  

If you’re a dermatologist, med spa owner, or healthcare entrepreneur, this episode is packed with **real-world strategies for building a sustainable, differentiated practice**.  

🔔 Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more insights from top leaders in aesthetics and wellness!  

#Dermatology #MedSpaBusiness #AestheticMedicine #Entrepreneurship #BalancedSkin

**🎥 Title:**  
Building Uptown Medspa: From Corporate Careers to a One-Stop Wellness Destination  

**📌 Description:**  
Welcome back to *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge* with your host, **Bethany Gifford**. In this episode, I sit down with the inspiring team behind **Uptown Medspa & Wellness** in Shelby, NC. What started as three separate businesses has grown into a true **one-stop destination for aesthetics, wellness, hormones, weight loss, and primary care**.  

✨ What you’ll learn in this episode:  
- 👩‍💼 The leap from **corporate careers** to launching a thriving med spa  
- 🤝 How three owners combined their skills under one powerful brand  
- 🧖‍♀️ Expanding beyond injectables—massage, IV therapy, hormones, weight loss & more  
- 📊 The systems they use for **patient retention and growth**  
- 📢 How they market through **events, community partnerships, and social media**  
- 🎯 Tackling the **stigma around med spas** with transparency & patient education  
- 💡 Coaching others: helping new med spa owners avoid the common pitfalls of starting out  

From their **signature “Tats & Toks” events** to their philosophy of slow, smart growth (no loans, no gimmicks, only services that truly fit client demand), the Uptown team shares practical wisdom for anyone in aesthetics and wellness.  

If you’re dreaming of opening your own med spa—or looking to expand your services sustainably—this episode is packed with insights you can apply today.  

🔔 Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more conversations with leaders shaping the future of aesthetics and wellness.  

#MedSpaBusiness #Aesthetics #Wellness #Entrepreneurship #UptownMedspa
